changes_made.explanation: Normalized task description to be more precise about persona-based generation. Added clearer output description. Tasks are properly categorized with 'Other:' prefix for custom tasks.
Normalized KL divergence spelling and removed duplicate entry. Only KL-divergence is used as the automatic metric for style distribution comparison.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The LLMs were only used for text generation, not evaluation.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. The evaluation was entirely automated using stylometric analysis and KL-divergence.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on stylometric analysis of persona-assigned LLM outputs using LISA embeddings and KL-divergence for automated comparison with human writing styles. No human or LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted. The extraction was generally accurate but needed minor normalization for consistency.
